text: 5d Edited Everybody makes mistakes, and we’re not afraid to admit that we messed up. When we designed the character of Vikram, we received some internal feedback that the design mirrored some of the harmful stereotypes of Sikhs that are portrayed in Bollywood films. So what happens when we make a mistake? We own up to it and try to rectify the situation. Although this was unintentional, it’s something that matters for us to get right. Language is deeply tied to culture, and representation matters greatly when we have learners all over the world. It’s also just the right thing to do. Because of this, two of the members of the Duolingo Design Department, Samia and Derek, led the charge to redesign Vikram in a more authentic way in 2024. 🙏 A heartfelt 'thank you' to the employees who spoke up and to the Duolingo Design Department’s dedicated and talented artists. Read more about the process of redesigning Vikram below. ⬇️ Vikram's redesign: From negative stereotypes to authentic representation Duolingo on LinkedIn 2,406 109 Comments Like Comment Share James Kirchner 5d So what was wrong with Vikram before? author: Kyle Poyar
text: 3d Edited It's here: What's working right now in B2B GTM, built on data from 300 software and AI companies 🎉 There are two ways to win: being exceptional at relationships and being exceptional at AI. Both ends of the barbell are working. But beware of the space in between. The most telling data to me is where teams are placing their bets for 2027. Drumroll please... 1. AI search (AEO) Last year B2B companies were still experimenting with AI search (AEO). It was hard to measure and seemed like SEO 2.0. Well, that’s clearly changed. AEO saw the biggest increase in adoption (by far) of any channel we tested. 2. Signal-based outreach Signals might be the buzziest buzzword in GTM right now. This year we asked which signals get acted on by GTM teams. It’s mostly content engagement (52% of respondents), website visits (42%), and product usage (40%). I think we can get much more creative here! 3. Intimate events It's one of the highest-ROI channels in the report. I hope you're hungry because dinners are coming in 2027. 4. LinkedIn posting Early-stage founders in particular are racing to become INfluencers. You'll probably see that in your feed if you haven't already. ... 16. Cold calling Cold calling fell to the bottom of the list. Hear me out on this one: will calling be less crowded (and perhaps more effective)? --- Maja Voje and I worked so hard on this report, we really hope you enjoy it.
